about: ClayMind's own Rule Cards (V5): short descriptions of common physical games, written for ClayMind in our own words (no copied text), table-scale. Used offline before any web search; cited as built-in.

cards.goal: Knock down as many standing pins as you can with a rolled ball.
cards.setup: Pins stand in a triangle at the far end; players roll from the near edge.
cards.turns: Each player rolls up to two balls per turn; fallen pins are cleared, then the next player.
cards.scoring: One point per pin down; all pins with the first ball is a strike (bonus).
cards.sizes: Ball about pin height; pins a ball-width apart.

cards.goal: Topple the skittles with a thrown or rolled ball.
cards.setup: Nine skittles in a diamond.
cards.turns: Three throws per player per turn.
cards.scoring: One point per skittle down; the most after a set number of turns wins.
cards.sizes: Skittles about twice as tall as wide.

cards.goal: Knock over the other side's blocks, then the king.
cards.setup: Each side's blocks stand on its own baseline; the king stands in the middle.
cards.turns: Teams take turns throwing all their sticks underhand at the far blocks.
cards.scoring: Toppling all the opponent's blocks and then the king wins; toppling the king early loses.
variants: fewer blocks on a small table
cards.sizes: Sticks longer than the blocks are tall.

cards.goal: Reach exactly the target score by knocking numbered pins.
cards.setup: Numbered pins stand close together in a tight group.
cards.turns: One throw per player per turn; pins are stood up where they fell.
cards.scoring: One pin down scores its number; several down score the count. Going over the target drops you back.
variants: target 25 instead of 50 for short games
cards.sizes: Pins about the same size; the thrower is a little longer.

cards.goal: Land bags on the board or through its hole.
pieces: a slanted board with a hole
cards.setup: The board sits at the far end, tilted toward the players.
cards.turns: Players alternate throws until all bags are thrown.
cards.scoring: Through the hole 3, on the board 1; first to 21 wins.
variants: only the difference between players counts each round
cards.sizes: The hole about three bags wide.

cards.goal: Throw rings over pegs.
cards.setup: Pegs stand in a group at the far end; nearer pegs score less.
cards.turns: Each player throws all their rings, then the next.
cards.scoring: Each peg has its own value; a ringed peg scores it.
variants: cups instead of pegs: a ring or ball inside counts
cards.sizes: Ring opening well wider than a peg.

cards.goal: Throw shoes to land around or close to a stake.
cards.setup: A stake stands at the far end.
cards.turns: Players throw both shoes, then the other player.
cards.scoring: A ringer 3, a shoe touching or very close 1; first to 21.

cards.goal: Toss a ball into the other side's cups.
cards.setup: Cups stand in a triangle at the far end.
cards.turns: Each player throws one or two balls per turn.
cards.scoring: A ball in a cup removes that cup; clearing all the cups wins.
cards.sizes: Cup mouth about two balls wide.

cards.goal: Roll balls up a ramp into scoring rings.
cards.setup: Rings at the top of a short ramp, smaller ones worth more.
cards.turns: Roll all your balls, then the next player.
cards.scoring: Each ring has its value; most points wins.
cards.sizes: Rings from two to four balls wide.

cards.goal: Flick a striker to sink your coins in the corner pockets.
pieces: a square board with corner pockets
cards.setup: Coins in a circle at the centre; each player strikes from their own baseline.
cards.turns: One flick per turn; sinking your coin gives another turn.
cards.scoring: Each coin of yours pocketed scores; the striker in a pocket loses a point.
variants: the queen coin worth more, covered by the next coin
cards.sizes: Coins small and flat; the striker a little bigger.

cards.goal: Flick discs toward the centre hole and knock the other player's away.
pieces: a round board with rings and a centre hole
cards.setup: Players flick from the outer edge of their quarter.
cards.turns: Players alternate one flick each until all discs are played.
cards.scoring: The centre hole 20, inner ring 15, middle 10, outer 5.

cards.goal: Hit the cue ball to sink your balls in the pockets.
cards.setup: Object balls in a triangle at one end.
cards.turns: Keep shooting while you pocket your own balls; a miss passes the turn.
cards.scoring: Each ball pocketed scores; the cue ball in a pocket is a foul.
variants: flick the cue ball instead of a cue

cards.goal: Slide weights as close to the far end as possible without falling off.
pieces: a long board with scoring zones
cards.setup: Scoring zones at the far end, the furthest worth most.
cards.turns: Players alternate sliding one weight.
cards.scoring: Zones 1, 2, 3; a weight hanging over the edge 4; off the board 0.

cards.goal: Slide stones closest to the target centre.
cards.setup: Rings at the far end.
cards.turns: Players alternate sliding one stone; stones can knock others away.
cards.scoring: Each of your stones nearer the centre than the other side's best scores 1.

cards.goal: Get your balls closest to the small target ball.
cards.setup: The target ball is thrown first.
cards.turns: The side further from the target throws next.
cards.scoring: Each ball nearer than the other side's nearest scores 1.
cards.sizes: The target ball about a third of the others.

cards.goal: Flick your shooter to knock marbles out of the ring.
cards.setup: Marbles in a cross in the middle of a ring.
cards.turns: Keep shooting while you knock marbles out.
cards.scoring: Each marble knocked out of the ring is yours; most wins.

cards.goal: Send marbles down a track to the finish.
cards.setup: The track slopes from a start to a finish.
cards.turns: Release marbles together or one at a time.
cards.scoring: First (or every) marble to the finish scores.

cards.goal: Get the ball into the hole in as few hits as possible.
cards.setup: Start at one end, the hole at the other with obstacles between.
cards.turns: Players take turns hitting their own ball.
cards.scoring: Count hits; fewest wins.
variants: flick the ball instead of a putter

cards.goal: Pull blocks from the tower and stack them on top without toppling it.
cards.setup: A tower of layers of three blocks, each layer crossed.
cards.turns: One block per turn, moved with one hand.
cards.scoring: The player who topples the tower loses.
variants: a short tower for a small table
cards.sizes: Blocks three times as long as wide.

cards.goal: Build the tallest steady tower.
pieces: blocks or pieces of any shape
cards.setup: A clear spot on the table.
cards.turns: Players take turns adding one piece.
cards.scoring: Height reached; the one who topples it loses.

cards.goal: Set up a line of standing pieces so one push topples them all.
cards.setup: Pieces stand in a line or curve, closer than their height.
cards.turns: Build, then push the first one.
cards.scoring: Every piece that falls counts.
cards.sizes: Gaps about half a piece's height.

cards.goal: Lift sticks from a pile without moving the others.
cards.setup: Drop the sticks in a loose pile.
cards.turns: Keep picking while nothing else moves.
cards.scoring: Each stick picked scores; most wins.

cards.goal: Flip small discs into a cup.
cards.setup: The cup in the middle; discs around it.
cards.turns: One flip per turn; potting gives another.
cards.scoring: Each disc in the cup scores.

cards.goal: Flick coins down the table and score through the goal.
pieces: a goal made of fingers or two blocks
cards.setup: Coins in a triangle at your end.
cards.turns: Flick one coin between the other two each go; three goes to score.
cards.scoring: A coin through the goal scores 1.
cards.sizes: Goal a little wider than a coin.

cards.goal: Slide a small flat piece so it stops hanging over the far edge.
cards.setup: Players sit at opposite ends.
cards.turns: Players alternate flicks.
cards.scoring: Over the edge but not falling 6; a flick through finger goalposts 1.

cards.goal: Hit the puck into the other side's goal.
cards.setup: Goals at each end; the puck in the middle.
cards.turns: Play at the same time, or take turns hitting.
cards.scoring: A goal scores 1; first to 7.
variants: take turns for a slower game

cards.goal: Throw pieces to land on the best ring of a target.
cards.setup: The target lies or stands at the far end.
cards.turns: Three throws per player per turn.
cards.scoring: Inner rings score more; most points after the turns wins.

cards.goal: Drop a ball through pegs into the best slot.
cards.setup: A sloped field of pegs above a row of slots.
cards.turns: Each player drops one ball per turn.
cards.scoring: The slot's value; most points wins.
cards.sizes: Gaps between pegs a little wider than a ball.

cards.goal: Build a pyramid of cups as fast as possible.
cards.setup: Cups in a pile at the start.
cards.turns: Players take turns against the clock.
cards.scoring: Fastest full pyramid wins; a fallen pyramid must be rebuilt.

cards.goal: Roll your piece down a slope furthest or first.
cards.setup: All pieces at the top of the ramp.
cards.turns: Release together.
cards.scoring: First past the line or furthest wins.
